definition: Selected T1 route has SLA promise support and no active Beck overlap warning
required_policy: Promise pair support plus passing stop chain and Beck diagnostics
design_treatment: Keep as normal T1 design line
gate_policy: Accepted action when selector and review gates pass
next_selector_use: Route remains selected unless future promise or budget changes remove it

definition: Selected promise-spine route shares a Beck backbone segment with another selected promise-spine route
required_policy: Shared segment must be represented as interlined trunk service or split at selected transfer stops without deleting either real route
design_treatment: Keep both routes selected while map policy resolves shared schematic treatment
gate_policy: Policy review does not block release but must remain visible in design review
next_selector_use: Map engine should consume overlap corridors before replacing hand-authored T1 chains

definition: Selected T1 route has no current 48h or 36h promise pair and was selected by score after promise routes consumed budget
required_policy: Route must gain an explicit national relay resilience market-coverage exception or be replaced by the strongest cutline route in the next selector pass
design_treatment: Keep visible as a T1 policy review until exception or demotion decision is recorded
gate_policy: Policy review does not block release but prevents treating the route as promise-spine accepted
next_selector_use: Selector should prefer promise-backed routes unless a documented score-backbone exception exists

definition: Route is a scored T1 candidate outside the current 11-route national budget
required_policy: No action unless budget expands or a selected route is demoted
design_treatment: Hold outside national T1 design and keep available for cutline comparison
gate_policy: Held candidates do not block release
next_selector_use: Selector can promote if budget expands or policy demotes a selected exception
